text_block_list.name: Senior Umamusume
text_block_list.text:
“—Let's both do our best today! See you 
out on the turf!”

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text: Yes, please take care of me...!

On the day of the Sprinters Stakes, senior 
Umamusume came to encourage Nishino Flower 
for her first time running in it.

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text: "...Senior looked so huge just now..."

Umamusume who compete in sprint races are 
generally quite muscular. The longer their 
career, the more pronounced this becomes.

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text:
"I'm worried that maybe from now on... the 
differences in our bodies are gonna show 
even more."

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text:
Trainer told me that sprints are the stage 
where I can truly shine.

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text:
I worked so hard at summer camp, and I 
really thought I'd gotten stronger. I was 
like, "I'm definitely gonna win!" ...And 
yet.

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text:
...Will it really be okay? If this doesn't 
work, I—

I put my conviction into those words. She 
had fought her way here, staying true to 
herself every step of the way. That's why—
choice_data_list: Believe in how hard you've worked.

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text: But...
choice_data_list: If it's too hard, just trust me!
If it's too hard, just trust me!

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
choice_data_list: You can become the greatest sprinter!
You can become the greatest sprinter!

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text: Trainer...

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text:
“...Is that so? Well, if you say so, 
Trainer...”

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text:
I can do it! ...Or at least, I want to 
believe... I can.

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text: No... I believe in you!

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text: Yes...!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text: You're here, Flower-san!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text:
I was dragged through the dirt at summer 
camp... Wait, sand? Covered in sand! But 
today!!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text: I'm going to win!

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text:
"That... wouldn't feel very good. I'd 
rather be the one leading the pack and 
taking the wind."

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text:
I experienced bitter disappointment last 
year. This year, I won't let anyone get 
ahead of me.

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text: ...! Trainer's... voice...

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text: *Inhale*... *exhale*... Alright.

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text: "I-I won't... back down either! So there!"

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text: I won't lose...!
